businessGoal: Allow visitors to find specific products within a category

scenarios.goal: Verify that the category page is displayed with the correct products and page title when a category name is clicked.
Verify that all filters (category checkboxes, brand checkboxes, sorting dropdown, pagination controls) are available on the category page.

manual.reason: The story describes visible behavior and user interaction on the category page.

api.reason: The story does not specify any API endpoints or behaviors that can be validated through API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible elements and user interactions on the UI.
